_comment: This replaces CODEOWNERS, which is INERT on private repos in a Free org.
Usernames are GitHub logins WITHOUT the @, and must be collaborators on
this repository. Rules are additive: every matching rule contributes its
reviewers. If nothing matches, 'default' is used.
Replace every *_USERNAME placeholder — the workflow skips them.
Keep this in sync with REVIEWERS.md.

rules._why: The contract crosses both repos: one frontend and one backend reviewer.
Auth is security-critical - two pairs of eyes.
CI, hooks and deploy config belong to Cloud/DevOps.
Shared UI components and tokens are used by every screen.
